recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-7813 unless a future Pharmacy/V2 mapping review separately reassesses other dispense-related MedicationRequest v2 mappings.
issue_request: FHIR-7813 is a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request for the DSTU1 MedicationPrescription v2 mapping table. It asked to change the Medication row from RXE-2-Give Code / RXO-1-Requested Give Code / RXD-2-Dispense/Give Code to RXE-2-Give Code / RXO-1-Requested Give Code / RXC-2-Component Code because a prescribed medication should not map to the dispense field RXD-2.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied in commit 651364cb098a623c36afc1d6b9d56578507d897c, whose subject explicitly lists tracker item 7813 and whose patch changed MedicationOrder.medication[x] from RXD-2-Dispense/Give Code to RXC-2-Component Code. Later source migrations preserved that mapping through MedicationOrder and then MedicationRequest.
additional_context: MedicationPrescription is no longer a current resource name; source/fhir.ini records that MedicationPrescription became MedicationRequest, and MedicationRequest is active in the current build. RXD mappings still appear on dispense-related or indication-related MedicationRequest elements, but not on MedicationRequest.medication, so they do not conflict with this issue. Jira search found no other RXC-2/RXD-2 MedicationPrescription tracker beyond FHIR-7813, and Zulip/Confluence searches found no community evidence changing the conclusion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The authoritative current source at source/medicationrequest/structuredefinition-MedicationRequest.xml already has the requested RXC-2 mapping on MedicationRequest.medication and does not have the old RXD-2 medication mapping on that element.
